emits.text: InvalidPurposes: purposes must be an object whose only member is links
emits.says: `/purposes` is an object whose only member is `links`, an array (`VE.Purposes.Wire.linksOf`).

emits.text: InvalidPurposes: link {link} must have id, relation, polarity, reason, target and marker, and may have share
emits.says: Each link has exactly `id`, `relation`, `polarity`, `reason`, `target` and `marker`, and may have `share` (`linkFieldsOk`).
A link's `id` and `marker`, and every part or mention id of a side, is a token (`idOf`).

emits.text: InvalidPurposes: link {link} has relation {relation}; a purposes link's relation is because or in order to
emits.says: A link's `relation` is `because` or `in order to` (`Relation.ofWire?`).

emits.text: InvalidPurposes: link {link} has polarity {polarity}; it must be affirmed or denied
InvalidPurposes: link {link} has share {share}; it must be plain, sole, partly or not_sole
emits.says: A link's `share`, when present, is `plain`, `sole`, `partly` or `not_sole` (`shareOf`).

emits.text: InvalidPurposes: link {link} has a side that is not a list of parts or mentions
emits.says: A link's `reason` and `target` are each an array of `{"part": id}` or `{"mention": id}` objects (`decodeSide`).

emits.text: InvalidPurposes: two links have the same id
emits.says: No two links have the same `id`: the one fault of `VE.Purposes.check` that reads no checked unit.
